title: PokéAPI: Pokémon Gen I–III
blurb: The first 386 Pokémon, Bulbasaur to Deoxys. One view is how they fight: the six base stats. The other is how they look: what a vision model sees in the little Game Boy Advance–era sprite.

notes.neighbors: Almost nobody keeps their friends. Charizard’s stat twin is Typhlosion (identical, stat for stat), but in looks its neighbors are Salamence and Dragonite. The rare trio that stays together is Whiscash, Lanturn and Dunsparce: stubby, rounded, middling in both worlds.

here: Here: all 386 Pokémon of Generations I–III (Bulbasaur to Deoxys, default forms, today's base stats and types), as their six base stats z-scored (A) and as DINOv2 embeddings of the classic front sprite, cropped and set on white (B); colours mark the primary type.
